selectionRule: Track parameters and the CLIPER fit use development storms only. Validation and permanent test storms are excluded from parameter fitting.

forcing.sidecarRule: HF-3 pressure winds are separate immutable sidecars; HF-1/HF-2 forcing bytes cannot be rewritten.

motion.initialization: Most recent agency motion at or before initialization, maximum 24-hour lookback; no future fixes.
motion.correction: Cosine taper to zero over the selected development-only lifetime.
motion.betaDrift: Northwestward, bounded, and scaled by storm size, intensity, and latitude.
motion.terrain: Small separately diagnosed differential-friction correction, bounded in m/s.
motion.wander: Development-calibrated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck residual; disabled in deterministic hindcasts.

claimRule: Legacy validation can reject a candidate but cannot establish an independent confirmatory claim after the model-development history. HF-6 must seal a new cohort.
